tyranitar-bulky-physical-attacker.label: Bulky attacker
tyranitar-bulky-physical-attacker.description: Summons a sandstorm and hits hard with Rock Slide, Earthquake, and Focus Punch from a bulky spread.

tyranitar-pursuit.label: Pursuit trapper
tyranitar-pursuit.description: Summons a sandstorm and catches fleeing Psychic and Ghost types with Pursuit.

swampert-surf-defensive.label: Physical wall (Roar)
swampert-surf-defensive.description: Soaks up physical attacks, spreads Toxic, and Roars away setup sweepers.

swampert-standard-offensive.label: Bulky attacker
swampert-standard-offensive.description: Attacks with Hydro Pump, Ice Beam, and Earthquake from a bulky spread, and cures its status with Refresh.

metagross-bulky-attacker.label: Bulky attacker
metagross-bulky-attacker.description: Hits hard with Meteor Mash and Earthquake from a bulky spread, scouting with Protect and taking a foe down with Explosion.

metagross-mixed.label: Mixed attacker
metagross-mixed.description: Mixes Meteor Mash with Psychic and Hidden Power Fire to break through walls of either kind, then Explodes.

gengar-defensive.label: Will-O-Wisp support (bulky)
gengar-defensive.description: Burns physical attackers with Will-O-Wisp, attacks with Thunderbolt and Ice Punch, and takes a foe down with Explosion.

gengar-utility.label: Will-O-Wisp support (fast)
gengar-utility.description: Outspeeds and burns physical attackers with Will-O-Wisp, attacks with Thunderbolt and Ice Punch, and takes a foe down with Explosion.

gengar-perish-trap.label: Perish trapper
gengar-perish-trap.description: Traps a foe with Mean Look and KOs it with Perish Song, Taunting healers and taking a foe down with Destiny Bond.

blissey-utility.label: Special wall
blissey-utility.description: Takes special hits all day, heals with Soft-Boiled, paralyzes with Thunder Wave, and chips away with Seismic Toss.

aerodactyl-taunt-lead.label: Taunt lead
aerodactyl-taunt-lead.description: Leads with Taunt to stop Spikes and setup, then attacks with Rock Slide, Earthquake, and Double-Edge.

celebi-leech-seed-3-attacks.label: Leech Seed attacker
celebi-leech-seed-3-attacks.description: Saps HP with Leech Seed and attacks with Giga Drain, Psychic, and Hidden Power Fire.

celebi-utility.label: Leech Seed support
celebi-utility.description: Saps HP with Leech Seed, heals with Recover, and Baton Passes out to a teammate.

snorlax-utility-lax.label: Bulky attacker
snorlax-utility-lax.description: Hits with Body Slam, Shadow Ball, and Earthquake from huge HP, and takes a foe down with Self-Destruct.

magneton-trapper.label: Steel trapper
magneton-trapper.description: Traps Steel types with Magnet Pull and takes them out with Thunderbolt and Hidden Power Fire.

jynx-perish-trapper.label: Perish trapper
jynx-perish-trapper.description: Puts a foe to sleep with Lovely Kiss, traps it with Mean Look, and KOs it with Perish Song from behind a Substitute.

charizard-sun.label: Sun attacker
charizard-sun.description: Sets sun with Sunny Day to power up Fire Blast, with Hidden Power Grass and Dragon Claw for coverage.

medicham-reversal.label: Reversal attacker
medicham-reversal.description: Behind a Substitute, Salac Berry and low HP power up Reversal and Focus Punch.

regirock-physical-attacker.label: Bulky attacker
regirock-physical-attacker.description: Hits with Rock Slide and Focus Punch, paralyzes with Thunder Wave, and takes a foe down with Explosion.

hariyama-offensive.label: Bulky attacker
hariyama-offensive.description: Hits with Focus Punch, Brick Break, and Rock Slide from huge HP, and removes items with Knock Off.

hariyama-defensive-knock-off.label: Knock Off support
hariyama-defensive-knock-off.description: Removes the foe's item with Knock Off, heals with Rest, and hits back with Brick Break.

kingdra-rain-dance-sweeper.label: Rain sweeper
kingdra-rain-dance-sweeper.description: Sets rain with Rain Dance; Swift Swim doubles its Speed for rain-boosted Surf and Hydro Pump.

houndoom-pursuit.label: Pursuit trapper
houndoom-pursuit.description: Catches fleeing Psychic and Ghost types with Pursuit and burns physical attackers with Will-O-Wisp.

venusaur-special-attacker.label: Leech Seed attacker
venusaur-special-attacker.description: Puts a foe to sleep with Sleep Powder, saps HP with Leech Seed, and attacks with Razor Leaf and Hidden Power Fire.

umbreon-wishpasser.label: Wish passer
umbreon-wishpasser.description: Passes big Wishes to teammates with Baton Pass and wears foes down with Toxic.

umbreon-mean-look-toxic.label: Toxic trapper
umbreon-mean-look-toxic.description: Traps a foe with Mean Look and wears it down with Toxic while it stalls with Protect and Wish.

blaziken-special-attacker.label: Mixed attacker (Salac Berry)
blaziken-special-attacker.description: Mixes Fire Blast, Thunder Punch, and Hidden Power Ice with Sky Uppercut, with a Salac Berry for Speed.

blaziken-mixed-sweeper.label: Mixed attacker (Leftovers)
blaziken-mixed-sweeper.description: Mixes Fire Blast with Focus Punch, Sky Uppercut, and Rock Slide to break through walls of either kind.

blaziken-reversal.label: Reversal attacker
blaziken-reversal.description: Behind a Substitute, Salac Berry and low HP power up Reversal, with Fire Blast and Hidden Power Ice for coverage.

marowak-all-out-attacker.label: Thick Club attacker
marowak-all-out-attacker.description: Thick Club doubles its Attack for Earthquake, Rock Slide, Double-Edge, and Focus Punch.

alakazam-encore.label: Encore attacker
alakazam-encore.description: Locks foes into their last move with Encore and attacks from behind a Substitute.

alakazam-special-trick.label: Trick attacker (special)
alakazam-special-trick.description: Attacks with Psychic and Fire Punch, then Tricks its Choice Band onto a wall to cripple it.

alakazam-physical-trick.label: Trick attacker (physical)
alakazam-physical-trick.description: Attacks with Psychic, Focus Punch, and Shadow Ball, then Tricks its Choice Band onto a wall to cripple it.

ludicolo-rain-dance-sweeper.label: Rain sweeper
ludicolo-rain-dance-sweeper.description: Sets rain with Rain Dance; Swift Swim doubles its Speed for Surf and Ice Beam, and Leech Seed wears foes down.

misdreavus-perish-trapper.label: Perish trapper
misdreavus-perish-trapper.description: Traps a foe with Mean Look and KOs it with Perish Song, Taunting healers and stalling with Protect.

misdreavus-imprison.label: Imprison support
misdreavus-imprison.description: Locks out foes that share its moves with Imprison, and paralyzes with Thunder Wave.

gardevoir-supporter.label: Wish support
gardevoir-supporter.description: Passes Wishes to teammates and attacks with Psychic and Thunderbolt.

lapras-offensive-utility.label: Bulky attacker
lapras-offensive-utility.description: Attacks with Hydro Pump, Ice Beam, and Thunderbolt from a bulky spread, and cures the team's status with Heal Bell.

scizor-reversal.label: Reversal attacker
scizor-reversal.description: Endures a hit, then uses Liechi Berry, Agility, and Swords Dance to power up a low-HP Reversal.

miltank-psych-up.label: Psych Up staller
miltank-psych-up.description: Copies the foe's boosts with Psych Up and heals with Milk Drink.

entei-sunnybeam.label: Sun sweeper
entei-sunnybeam.description: Sets sun with Sunny Day to power up Flamethrower and fire Solar Beam without charging, boosted by Calm Mind.

exeggutor-sunnybeam.label: Sun sweeper
exeggutor-sunnybeam.description: Sets sun with Sunny Day to fire Solar Beam without charging, with Sleep Powder and Hidden Power Fire.

exeggutor-stall.label: Bulky attacker
exeggutor-stall.description: Puts a foe to sleep with Sleep Powder, attacks with Psychic and Giga Drain, and takes a foe down with Explosion.

lanturn-parafusion.label: Paralysis support
lanturn-parafusion.description: Paralyzes with Thunder Wave and confuses with Confuse Ray, then attacks while foes struggle to move.

quagsire-counter.label: Counter wall
quagsire-counter.description: Takes physical hits and returns them double with Counter, resetting setup with Haze.

omastar-rain-dance-sweeper.label: Rain sweeper
omastar-rain-dance-sweeper.description: Sets rain with Rain Dance; Swift Swim doubles its Speed for rain-boosted Surf.
